description: District secretariat - Ratnapura- Pilgrimages ordinance (Chapter 175) Sri Pada Pilgrimage Season 2024/2025
categorisation: This gazette primarily concerns the announcement and enforcement of regulations for the Sri Pada pilgrimage season under the Pilgrimages Ordinance. It references specific legal notifications from previous gazettes and outlines detailed regulatory requirements for various aspects of the pilgrimage (lodging, construction, sanitation, commerce, etc.), making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or other specialized category.
